candidate_relation_groups.statement: U1 exact bytes -> U2 decoded semantic register via first/second JSON decode.
U2 semantic register -> U3 + U4 via projection, preserving version/order/issues.
U3 + U4 -> U2 only when register version, ordering, issue statements and aggregation convention are recoverable.
M1/M2 semantic fields may be recomputable from source configs, but that changes continuation into recomputation.
U3 baseline facts and U4 pair facts are independent at fact level.
U5 provenance is not semantically entailed by U1/U2 and may be independent of narrow task decision.
Identity, locator, retrieval and semantic reconstruction may be distinct rather than one access pipeline.
Task projection, adoption, behavioral effect and continuation are sequential candidates but may partially collapse.
Pair blocks may denote coexistence constraints, not individual blocks; M1.b may anchor that distinction.
M1.b function may arise from baseline-compatible slot interacting with pair decisions, not from gamma-blocked information alone.
